panels.description: The Dude steps onto lane 3 in his worn bathrobe, sunglasses and bazaar chappals. The crowned lane, standing pin, recovered dhurrie and oversized GODARAZ z align in one clean perspective. Duda watches from the ball return. Keep upper-left lane space clear.

Behind The Dude, the contradictory bilingual rule board is visible as two separate strips reserved for lettering. Walter grips his laminated rulebook while Guddu, Pinty and Bua-ji watch from the side. Keep the upper area clear.
The Dude releases the ball without hurry down lane 3. Use the long lane as the dominant shape and keep upper-right travel space clear.

The ball knocks down the final pin. Naturalistic hands, faces and bodies break into motion rather than a posed cheer. Include a compact scoreboard clearly reading 49–48 without competing with the impact. Keep lower-right lane space clear.

items.speaker: DUDA
items.text: The parrot is not an umpire.
